concept: A snug open-air woodland cafe where Baristabbit welcomes neighbours with warm drinks and soft baked treats.
floor: One broad continuous honey-oak cafe floor across the full top face, formed from only six to eight oversized softly beveled planks with no seams, crumbs, rugs, or separate paths.
main_structure: One broad open-front cream-and-caramel cafe pavilion at the rear with a softly arched terracotta roof, one large service opening, and one simple steaming-cup silhouette above the opening without text.
rear_props: one broad rounded service counter with one oversized coffee pot and two large cup forms
two large amber cafe lanterns flanking the rear pavilion
side_props: one chunky curved cafe bench and one broad round table on the upper-left edge
one compact pastry trolley with three oversized bun forms and one broad planter on the upper-right edge

perimeter.material: one continuous smooth sage-green cafe-garden border with broad cream capstones
perimeter.emblems: four oversized simple cup-and-paired-ear silhouette emblems

materials: a few broad muted terracotta blocks

lighting: soft warm morning light with one gentle service-window glow and two large amber lantern pools
must_keep: exact canonical camera, canvas, footprint, stairs, tapered underside, and padding
entire bottom/front half as quiet open honey-oak floor
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature, rabbit, person, or egg baked into the bitmap
center circle, platform, plaza, ring, rug, path, or indentation
bridges, clouds, readable menu, labels, text, watermark, external shadow
tiny food pieces, tableware clutter, crumbs, steam particles, flowers, grass blades, pebbles, cracks, specks, or dense texture
